items.title: Matter Smart Home Displays don't exist... so I built one
items.description: Smart home dashboards are everywhere, but they all have the same problem — they're just pretty screens sitting on top of your existing hub. If the hub goes down, so does your dashboard. So I built one that skips that entirely. This mini display talks *directly* to my lights, sensors, and even a custom-built weather device using Matter's binding feature — no hub in the loop for control, just device-to-device communication over Thread. In this video I cover: - How Matter binding actually works (clusters, servers vs. clients) - Extending a light switch's clusters to pull in temperature, humidity, and air quality data - Building a *virtual* Matter weather device with matter.js (and why I eventually ditched it for two ESP32s) - The absolute nightmare that is time sync in Matter, and how I worked around it - Real-world battery life testing and power optimisation - The honest trade-offs of living with a fully native Matter setup day to day If you want to build one yourself, full instructions are on GitHub 👇 🔧 Build it yourself: GitHub repo: https://github.com/uamphome/mini_matter_display 🛒 Hardware used: Waveshare ESP32-C6 AMOLED display: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3kYGeLd Thread border router board: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c33n4Qrz *Links above are affiliate links — I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you if you purchase through them. It helps support the channel.* #Matter #SmartHome #ESP32 #homeassistant #DIY
